source.snippet: Ask HN: What is one simple thing LLMs are insanely bad at? — I am looking for ideas on what to train a specialized model for! What is one simple thing you repeatedly ask ChatGPT, Claude, or another model to do that it still somehow messes up? (7 points, 10 comments, captured 2026-08-26)

problem_statement: Developers and power users repeatedly encounter the same narrow failure modes in general-purpose LLMs (e.g. counting, formatting, structured extraction, domain-specific reasoning) and have no practical path to a cheap, reliable specialized model that fixes just that one thing.
target_segment: Developers and technical founders who use LLM APIs in production and hit consistent, reproducible failure modes that degrade their product quality.
notes: Post is recent (2026-08-26) and gathering active responses. Buyer signal is moderate: developers using paid LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) are already spending money and seeking a cheaper or more reliable alternative for specific sub-tasks. The opportunity is a marketplace or service for narrow fine-tuned models, but the signal is still early-stage idea exploration rather than explicit willingness-to-pay evidence.
